links.outcome: Agreement of ChatGPT-4o oncologic recommendations with multidisciplinary tumor board decisions
links.effect: Full agreement in 56.1% of cases, correct but incomplete in 23.5%, partially accurate but flawed in 18.4%; Cohen's kappa 0.61. Discrepancies most common in metastatic prostate cancer (tumor burden misclassification, treatment sequencing errors).
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o fully agreed with the MTB in 56.1% of cases, was correct but incomplete in 23.5%, and provided partially accurate but flawed recommendations in 18.4%.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of ChatGPT-4o recommendations compared with actual multidisciplinary tumor board decisions across 98 urology cases.
